name: comment-tune
description: Tunes code comments: trim the noise, fill in missing context, fix stale ones.

interface.shortDescription: Cut the noise. Keep the context.
interface.longDescription: Keeps code comments to what the code can't say: trims noise, fills in missing context, fixes stale comments. Never changes code.
defaultPrompt: Tune the comments in my current diff.
Audit the comments in this repository.
